english:
Weapon fires Full Auto. On all Weapon Types except Shotguns, this is identical to the Full Auto Firing setting in Gameplay.

Decreases Firing Delay by 10% on Shotguns.

Passively grants 5 Stability on The Last Dance, The Last Perdition, and Lonesome.

source.text:
Passively grants 0.9x Refire Delay on Shotguns.
The perk version of the "Full Auto Firing" setting in Gameplay on every other Weapon Type.

+And I guess it grants +5 Stability on The Last Dance, The Last Perdition, and Lonesome.
